2608.11840.title: User-Assisted Collaborative Distributed Inference for Efficient QoS-Aware Autoscaling
2608.11840.paper_summary: Growing demand for artificial intelligence (AI) inference services requires scalable infrastructure, yet centralized serving costs rise with demand. We propose a collaborative distributed inference system combining dedicated infrastructure with resources contributed by service users. Dedicated resources provide baseline capacity for maintaining quality of service (QoS), while volunteered resources absorb increasing demand without proportional growth in centralized infrastructure. To capture stochastic and dynamic interactions among users, resources, tasks, and policies, we develop a high-dimensional generative Markov model with structured temporal factorization. The model supports simulation and provides a foundation for task scheduling and QoS-aware resource allocation optimization. We evaluate the system across user populations, resource capacities, and centralized and distributed scheduling policies. Simulations show that distributed scheduling becomes increasingly advantageous as the user population grows, improving request completion and P99 latency while substantially reducing dedicated resource consumption. These results demonstrate the feasibility of user-assisted collaborative inference for infrastructure-efficient autoscaling.
2608.11840.paper_summary_zh: 對人工智慧（AI）推理服務日益增長的需求要求可擴展的基礎設施，但隨著需求的增加，集中式服務的成本也上升。我們提出了一種協作式分散推理系統，結合了專用基礎設施和服務用戶貢獻的資源。專用資源提供維持服務質量（QoS）的基線能力，而自願提供的資源則在不成比例增長集中式基礎設施的情況下吸收日益增長的需求。為了捕捉用戶、資源、任務和政策之間的隨機和動態互動，我們開發了一種具有結構化時間因式分解的高維生成馬爾可夫模型。該模型支持模擬並為任務調度和考慮QoS的資源分配優化提供基礎。我們在用戶群體、資源容量以及集中式和分散式調度政策之間評估該系統。模擬結果顯示，隨著用戶群體的增長，分散式調度變得越來越有利，提高了請求完成率和P99延遲，同時顯著減少了專用資源的消耗。這些結果證明了用戶協助的協作推理在基礎設施高效自動擴展中的可行性。
